Name: Helena's Cat Replacement - Aipom
Author: helenaneedshugs
Description:
Replaces the default cat with Aipom from Pokemon.
Based on the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time / Darkness sprites.

[b]How to install:[/b]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. [url=https://i.imgur.com/zBLScEy.png]Unzip[/url] the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI!

To uninstall, just delete the "Aipom Cat Replacement" folder in \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
